name: Synthesia
tagline: Synthesia is the leading AI video generation platform for creating professional presenter videos without cameras, studios, or actors. You type a script, choose from 160+ AI avatars in 120+ languages, and receive a polished video in minutes. Enterprise L&D teams, communications departments, and content marketers use Synthesia to produce training videos, product explainers, and multilingual corporate content at scale.
